description:
## [1.1.1](https://github.com/sftsang/sportsnet-patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.1.1) (2026-11-24)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Update Scores locks after signing in ([e4eaae8](https://github.com/sftsang/sportsnet-patches/commit/e4eaae87b90d198fd5b4ee05d70583905fe3b306))

patches.name: Custom bottom tabs
patches.description: Chooses which tabs the bottom bar shows, their order, and the tab the app opens on.

options.description: Show the Home tab in the bottom bar.
Show the Scores tab in the bottom bar.
Show the Leagues tab in the bottom bar.
Show the Watch tab in the bottom bar.
Show the More tab in the bottom bar.
Show the Highlights tab, in versions of the app that have one.
The tab the app opens on. A hidden tab can still be the start tab.
Optional. Tab names in the order you want, separated by commas, such as watch, scores. Shown tabs left out go after them. Leave empty for Sportsnet's order.

patches.name: Custom skip intervals
patches.description: Sets separate fast forward and rewind times for the Sportsnet+ player's skip buttons.

options.description: Seconds the fast forward button skips.
Seconds the rewind button goes back.

patches.name: Disable game alerts
patches.description: Turns off game alerts, live score notifications and Airship's pop-up messages and tracking, and stops the app from asking to send notifications.

patches.name: Disable tracking
patches.description: Stops Adobe, Comscore, New Relic, Chartbeat, Firebase, Conviva and Youbora from collecting and sending data about you and what you watch.

patches.name: Hide Listen button
patches.description: Removes the Listen (radio and podcasts) button from the top of Home, Scores and Leagues.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes banner, in-feed and launch ads, and the ads in highlight videos. Ads inside Sportsnet+ streams are part of the stream and are not removed.

patches.name: Hide leagues
patches.description: Keeps the Scores and Watch tabs to the leagues you follow.

options.description: League names as Sportsnet shows them, separated by commas, such as NHL, ATP, WTA. Other leagues are hidden; Watch tab videos that name no league stay. Leave empty to show all.
League names to always hide, separated by commas, such as MLS, WNBA.

patches.name: Save watch position often
patches.description: Saves how far you got in a Sportsnet+ replay while you watch and after you skip, not only when you pause or close it, so the place is kept if the app is closed or killed.

options.description: Seconds between saves while a video plays.

patches.name: Stay on Scores when watching
patches.description: Opens games tapped on Scores on top of Scores, so going back from the video returns to Scores instead of the Watch tab.

patches.name: Video quality
patches.description: Sets the quality the Sportsnet+ player starts at and stays within, and shows the player's hidden HDR setting.

options.description: Bitrates as max,min,start in kbps; -1 leaves one to the player.

patches.name: Watch from Scores
patches.description: Shows a watch button on every Scores game: Watch Live while a game is on, Watch Full Game once it is over. Games you cannot watch show a lock and the reason.

options.description: Start the game as soon as it opens, instead of showing its Sportsnet+ page first.

patches.name: Watch tab opens on a league
patches.description: Adds a league page as the first Watch sub-tab, so the Watch tab opens on it.

options.description: The sub-tab's label and page path, as Label=/path, such as NHL=/nhl. Leave empty to keep the Watch tab as it is. Nothing changes if the app does not have that page.
